productionScope: Geometry-only groups/cuts/UV, default generated and automatic fill; not a complete React build.

regression.note: New narrow-connector reflection means unconstrained ARAP must not overwrite it. Two large panels still required to reduce energy; connector now required to satisfy actual reflection contract. Rerun passed.

failuresAndCorrections: Initial concurrent whole-model test was killed by memory pressure during the final Helmet variant; not counted as passing. Worker termination is now awaited; current complete six-path test reran sequentially with explicit GC and passed.

First synthetic narrow-surface RMS test assumed curved surfaces with different tessellations were exactly identical; replaced with genuinely reflected piecewise-linear geometry, without relaxing production gates.

Initial structure-relax regression required ARAP on every panel, including a newly recognized symmetric connector. Updated to assert two main panels improve and the connector retains its validated reflection.
Initial exploratory bevel merge did not compile due to an incorrect topology member name. Corrected to source triangle edges before accepting/committing the implementation.
First browser test used unsupported hide/ghost context strings; final test uses hidden/dim and explicitly checks the option, with a full rerun.
nonClaims: No use of source UV in generation. QA-only fixed face counts select matching test components, never production rules.
No optimal packing or all-model semantic/symmetry guarantee.
Offline WebGL passing is not Three/React/macOS/Windows browser certification.
